integrity: An analytic all-dimension proof accompanies the theorem. Numerical tests are corroboration and do not constitute independent validation. Prior two-point ball-spindle results are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Leading-order small-body asymptotic for two independent uniform points in origin-symmetric Euclidean convex bodies; no finite-scale inequality, noisy-sample assertion, or nonsymmetric reconstruction. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp small-scale spindle-absorption law and Euclidean-ball rigidity
